assertions.subject: Septic Arthritis
assertions.quote: Septic arthritis may be signified by pain

assertions.subject: Septic Arthritis
assertions.quote: Septic arthritis may be signified by pain, erythema

assertions.subject: Septic Arthritis
assertions.quote: Septic arthritis may be signified by pain, erythema, and effusion

assertions.subject: Septic Arthritis
assertions.predicate: pain upon passive or active range of motion
assertions.quote: significant pain upon passive or active range of motion

assertions.subject: Paronychia
assertions.quote: Erythema, swelling, and effusion of the lateral or proximal nail fold indicate paronychia

assertions.subject: Eponychia
assertions.quote: Erythema, swelling, and effusion of the lateral or proximal nail fold indicate paronychia or eponychia

assertions.subject: Felon
assertions.quote: Erythema, effusion, and pain in the pulp of the fingertip may represent the presence of a felon

assertions.subject: Herpetic Whitlow
assertions.quote: A herpetic whitlow is oftentimes signified by digital pain and erythema

assertions.subject: Abscess
assertions.quote: Palpation of fluctuance in the setting of localized erythema and effusion suggests the presence of an abscess

assertions.subject: Osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: A patient with osteomyelitis oftentimes has risk factors predisposing them to this condition, and on a physical exam may demonstrate localized erythema

assertions.subject: Flexor Tenosynovitis
assertions.quote: Presence of some or all of Kanavel’s cardinal signs may indicate the presence of flexor tenosynovitis
